learned.lesson: A guard on a not-yet-generated artifact makes the whole dispatch fail closed.
learned.why: the dispatcher refuses rather than reporting a vacuous clean subject.
learned.change: generate every guard root before assembling the guard set

learned.lesson: A fixed-path lane receipt loses the refused attempt's first-fail when a retry succeeds.
learned.why: the retry overwrites the file at turn end; the failure evidence vanishes silently.
learned.change: copy an existing receipt aside or use attempt-numbered receipt paths

learned.lesson: A checker whose sandbox is read-only cannot execute a harness that writes or edits ACLs, so it must return UNVERIFIABLE, not AGREE.
learned.why: correct refusal; the round's job is then to narrow the claim, not to argue.
learned.change: state in the brief which claims are source-checkable and which need execution, and pre-record the maker-side executions so the checker at least sees their receipts

learned.lesson: Search-and-reuse and prompt de-duplication are in direct tension.
learned.why: reusing a governance scaffold produced 0.596 shingle similarity, which the duplication gate flags as self-plagiarism even though the executed prompt was newly authored.
learned.change: scope the duplication gate to the executed prompt, not the plan contract

learned.lesson: A plan document's filename is not part of the plan's content.
learned.why: both recon lanes spent time locating it; content with the document is what matters.
learned.change: state the absolute path of every referenced plan file in each brief

learned.lesson: A self-check whose success argument is a literal is worse than no check.
learned.why: the previous round's S8b could never fail and its computed guard was dead code; an independent lane proved it by AST scan.
learned.change: every probe must ship a mutation the probe is required to catch; the round's own harness now runs 14 injected mutations and refuses a verdict without them

verification_of_change: each lesson is recorded with the artifact that evidenced it; the harness change (self_check.py --negative-control) is exercised in SELF_CHECK_RECEIPT.json
